about: The feedback after a turn: by outcome (feedback.outcome.<key>), by the core's error tag (feedback.error.<tag>), and the fallback.

strings.feedback.outcome.understood_with_mistake: {npc} understood you, but there was a small mistake. That is fine: keep going.
strings.feedback.outcome.not_understood: {npc} did not understand that. Try again, press H for help, or press W to type.
strings.feedback.outcome.off_prompt: {npc} understood, but that is not what was asked.
strings.feedback.outcome.uncertain: I could not hear that clearly. That is the microphone, not your Spanish. Try again, or press W to type.
strings.feedback.outcome.dont_know: That is fine. Not knowing is part of learning. Here is the phrase to say.
strings.feedback.outcome.help: Here is some help. Try the phrase on the card.
strings.feedback.outcome.choice: You picked one of the offered phrases. Next time, try saying it yourself.
strings.feedback.outcome.fail_forward: That is fine. The game carries on: you do not need to say it perfectly to continue.
strings.feedback.outcome.pointed: {npc} points to the {noun}, {blocks} blocks away. Follow the arrow.
strings.feedback.error.vocab.wrong: A different word fits here: “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.vocab.unknown: The game does not know the word “{actual}”. Check the spelling, or try another word.
strings.feedback.error.conj.person: The verb ending must match who is speaking. Say “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.conj.tense: The verb is in a different time (tense). Try “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.conj.irregular: This verb is irregular, so it does not follow the usual pattern. Say “{expected}”, not “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.gender.agree: Spanish nouns are masculine or feminine, and the words next to them must match. Say “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.noun.number: One or more than one? The noun and the words next to it must match. Say “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.ser_estar: Spanish has two words for “to be”: ser and estar. Try “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.word_order: The words go in a different order in Spanish. Try “{expected}” instead of “{actual}”.
strings.feedback.error.pron.vowel: A vowel sounded a little different. Spanish vowels are short and clear: a, e, i, o, u.
strings.feedback.error.pron.r: The Spanish “r” is a quick tap of the tongue, not the English “r”.
strings.feedback.error.pron.silent_h: The letter “h” is silent in Spanish. Do not pronounce it.
strings.feedback.error.pron.stress: The stress falls on a different part of the word. Listen again and copy the rhythm.
strings.feedback.unknownError: There was a small mistake in “{actual}”. Listen to the guide's version and try again.
